name: Phulay Bay, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve
short_description: The world's first Ritz-Carlton Reserve, an ultra-luxury 54-key retreat of private pavilions and pool villas with butler service on Krabi's Andaman coast north of Ao Nang.
ai_summary: Phulay Bay, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve opened in 2009 as the first property in Ritz-Carlton's rarefied Reserve collection, and independent reviewers still treat it as a benchmark for barefoot luxury in Thailand. Set on the Andaman coast in Nong Thale, north of Ao Nang, the resort comprises just 54 pavilions and villas, many with private plunge pools, double-height ceilings and traditional Thai design touches. Writers consistently single out the personalized 'Ton Hong' butler service as a genuine standout, alongside dramatic open-air architecture, a much-photographed infinity pool overlooking limestone islands, and a spa with vitality pools and jungle-lagoon views. Dining across multiple outlets and an extensive breakfast buffet draw praise, and unique experiences such as Thai cooking classes, batik and shadow-puppet workshops, and a complimentary boat shuttle to Koh Hong round out the appeal. Honest watch-outs recur: the property fronts a mangrove-lined shore rather than a swimmable beach, so guests rely on the island shuttle for classic sand-and-sea time; pricing is firmly ultra-luxury; and reviewers redeeming Marriott points have reported breakfast being charged separately. Minor room quibbles (few bedside outlets, no towel rails) surface in older reviews. On balance the consensus is that the experience justifies the steep rates, and the resort is ranked #1 of 18 hotels in Krabi on TripAdvisor.

faqs.question: Does Phulay Bay have its own swimming beach?
faqs.answer: Not really. The resort fronts a scenic mangrove-lined Andaman shore rather than a classic sandy swimming beach. Guests use the resort's complimentary boat shuttle to nearby Koh Hong island for sand, snorkeling and open-sea swimming, and enjoy the infinity pool and private villa plunge pools on-site.

faqs.question: How far is the resort from Krabi International Airport?
faqs.answer: Phulay Bay sits in Nong Thale, north of Ao Nang, roughly 40 km from Krabi International Airport (KBV), around a 40-to-50-minute drive depending on traffic. The resort can arrange private airport transfers with butler coordination, and Ao Nang's beach and shops are about 13 km away.

faqs.question: What makes Phulay Bay a Ritz-Carlton 'Reserve' rather than a standard Ritz-Carlton?
faqs.answer: Reserve is Ritz-Carlton's most exclusive tier, with only a handful of properties worldwide. Phulay Bay, which opened in 2009, was the first. Expect a small 54-key footprint, private pavilions and pool villas, dedicated 'Ton Hong' butlers and bespoke local experiences rather than a large conventional resort.

reviews.title: Review: Phulay Bay, a Ritz Carlton Reserve resort, Krabi, Thailand
reviews.author: Rhys Jones
reviews.summary: Praises expansive private villas, striking open-air design and impeccable butler service, comparing it to Four Seasons Langkawi; notes small gaps like few bedside outlets and no towel rails, concluding you get what you pay for.
